{{Top}}
A '''survey droid''' or '''scout droid''' was a class of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed to search unexplored [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. [[Cassander Tadrin]] employed survey droids to discover the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that would come to be known as the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]].
